author: Forbes
description:

Hear what it takes to stop waiting and start putting agents to work. 

Forbes Chief Innovation Officer Nina Gould sits down with Select Health CIO Ryan Brady and Salesforce CIO & Chief Architect - Regulated Industries & Canada - Mark Wanish  at the 2026 Forbes CIO Summit.
